about: One account's history-<hash>.sqlite as this build (user_version 1) writes it: message bodies and the conversation's info are JSONEncoder output stored as BLOBs (sentAt is seconds since 2001-01-01). msg-3 has no `tables` key, as a build before markdown tables wrote it. msg-gone is deleted for me: a later write of it must not bring it back. Seeded with `sql`, opened through ConversationHistoryDatabase, read with newest(), info() and syncedRange(); `newer_build_sql` stands in for a later build (a new column and table, a newer user_version) and the same reads must hold. Test: ConversationHistoryPersistedFormatTests (conversationHistoryFixturesLoad).
sql: CREATE TABLE messages (conversation TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (conversation, id))
CREATE INDEX messages_by_seq ON messages (conversation, seq)
CREATE TABLE conversations (conversation TEXT PRIMARY KEY, info BLOB, me_id TEXT, oldest_seq INTEGER, newest_seq INTEGER, complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, written_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE deleted (conversation TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (conversation, id))
